```{r}
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m4_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~
    hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)

cat("\n--- Model 4 (lag) summaries ---\n")
summary(fit_m4_hearing_lag); cox.zph(fit_m4_hearing_lag)
summary(fit_m4_vision_lag);  cox.zph(fit_m4_vision_lag)
summary(fit_m4_frailty_lag); cox.zph(fit_m4_frailty_lag)

# ============================================================================
# 6) Model 5 (3-level sensory x frailty context) - lag-restricted
#    Re-use build_m5_dataset(), drop participants whose dementia event
#    time is <= LAG_YEARS, then refit. Per-level case data is intentionally
#    NOT printed here -- fit_m5() prints it on the lagged dataset.
# ============================================================================

# ---- Self-contained formatter ---------------------------------------------
fmt_int <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")

report_counts <- function(dat, id = "idauniq", event = "event",
                          ts = "tstart", tp = "tstop", label = "") {
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
  n_intervals <- nrow(dat)
  n_persons   <- dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[id]])
  n_events    <- sum(dat[[event]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_pyrs      <- sum(dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]], na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf(
    "%-40s intervals = %s | persons = %s | events = %s | person-years = %s\n",
    label,
    fmt(n_intervals),
    fmt(n_persons),
    fmt(n_events),
    formatC(n_pyrs, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
  ))
  invisible(list(intervals = n_intervals, persons = n_persons,
                 events = n_events, person_years = n_pyrs))
}

# ---- Lag exclusion helper (totals only; fit_m5 handles per-level output) --
apply_lag_m5 <- function(dat, lag_years = LAG_YEARS, label = "") {
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")

  early_ids <- dat %>%
    filter(dementia_event == 1L, stop <= lag_years) %>%
    pull(idauniq) %>%
    unique()

  out <- dat %>% filter(!idauniq %in% early_ids)

  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Lag exclusion (<= %g years)\n", label, lag_years))
  cat(sprintf("  Excluded participants (early dementia): %s\n",
              fmt(length(early_ids))))
  report_counts(dat, id = "idauniq", event = "dementia_event",
                ts = "start", tp = "stop",
                label = sprintf("  %s primary:", label))
  report_counts(out, id = "idauniq", event = "dementia_event",
                ts = "start", tp = "stop",
                label = sprintf("  %s lagged :", label))

  out
}

# ---- Apply lag + refit Model 5 --------------------------------------------
df_tv_hearing_lag <- apply_lag_m5(df_tv_hearing, label = "HEARING")
df_tv_vision_lag  <- apply_lag_m5(df_tv_vision,  label = "VISION")

fit_m5_hearing_lag <- fit_m5(df_tv_hearing_lag, "HEARING (lag 2 waves)")
fit_m5_vision_lag  <- fit_m5(df_tv_vision_lag,  "VISION  (lag 2 waves)")

contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_hearing_lag, "HEARING (lag)")
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_vision_lag,  "VISION  (lag)")
```

```{r}
# 7) PAF on the lag-restricted samples (ELSA)
#    Re-uses paf_binary_fn / paf_ci_binary / paf_ci_multicat / prev_pt_*
#    defined in the primary ELSA script.
# ============================================================================
set.seed(20260509)

# ---- A) Person-time prevalences in tv_cc_lag (for Models 1-4) -------------
p_hearing_14_lag <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_lag, "hearing_lag", "tstart", "tstop")
p_vision_14_lag  <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_lag, "vision_lag",  "tstart", "tstop")
p_frailty_14_lag <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_lag, "frailty_lag", "tstart", "tstop")

cat("\nPerson-time-weighted prevalence (tv_cc_lag):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Hearing loss : %.4f\n", p_hearing_14_lag))
cat(sprintf("  Vision loss  : %.4f\n", p_vision_14_lag))
cat(sprintf("  Frailty      : %.4f\n", p_frailty_14_lag))

paf_row <- function(fit, term, p, model_label, exposure_label) {
  res <- paf_ci_binary(fit, term, p)
  tibble(
    model    = model_label,
    exposure = exposure_label,
    p_pt     = p,
    HR       = res$HR,
    PAF      = res$PAF,
    PAF_lcl  = res$lcl,
    PAF_ucl  = res$ucl
  )
}

paf_models_1_4_lag <- bind_rows(
  # Model 1
  paf_row(fit_m1_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M1 (unadjusted) [lag]",          "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M1 (unadjusted) [lag]",          "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M1 (unadjusted) [lag]",          "Frailty"),

  # Model 2
  paf_row(fit_m2_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M2 (+ age) [lag]",               "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M2 (+ age) [lag]",               "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M2 (+ age) [lag]",               "Frailty"),

  # Model 3
  paf_row(fit_m3_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M3 (+ socio + lifestyle) [lag]", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M3 (+ socio + lifestyle) [lag]", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M3 (+ socio + lifestyle) [lag]", "Frailty"),

  # Model 4 (PRIMARY hybrid)
  paf_row(fit_m4_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj) [lag]", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj) [lag]", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M4 (mutually adjusted) [lag]",   "Frailty")
)

cat("\n--- PAF: Models 1-4 (lag) ---\n")
print(paf_models_1_4_lag, n = Inf)

# ---- B) PAF for Model 5 (lag) ---------------------------------------------
paf_model5 <- function(fit, dat, model_label) {
  stopifnot(is.factor(dat$ctx_lag))
  ctx_levels   <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)
  exposed_lvls <- ctx_levels[-1]

  prev_tab  <- prev_pt_factor(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")
  p_exposed <- setNames(prev_tab$p[match(exposed_lvls, prev_tab$level)],
                        exposed_lvls)
  stopifnot(all(!is.na(p_exposed)), all(p_exposed > 0))

  terms <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed_lvls)
  miss  <- setdiff(terms, names(coef(fit)))
  if (length(miss))
    stop("Missing coefficients in Model 5 fit: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  tab <- paf_ci_multicat(fit, terms, p_exposed, exposed_lvls)
  tab %>%
    mutate(
      model    = model_label,
      exposure = component,
      p_pt     = c(NA_real_, unname(p_exposed))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl = lcl, PAF_ucl = ucl)
}

paf_m5_hearing_lag <- paf_model5(fit_m5_hearing_lag, df_tv_hearing_lag,
                                 "M5 (hearing context) [lag]")
paf_m5_vision_lag  <- paf_model5(fit_m5_vision_lag,  df_tv_vision_lag,
                                 "M5 (vision context) [lag]")

cat("\n--- PAF: Model 5 hearing (lag) ---\n"); print(paf_m5_hearing_lag, n = Inf)
cat("\n--- PAF: Model 5 vision  (lag) ---\n"); print(paf_m5_vision_lag,  n = Inf)

# ---- C) Combined summary (lag) --------------------------------------------
paf_all_lag <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4_lag, paf_m5_hearing_lag, paf_m5_vision_lag) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                     100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_CI)

cat("\n=== Combined PAF summary - SENSITIVITY (lag 2 waves, ELSA) ===\n")
print(paf_all_lag, n = Inf)
```

# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS (ELSA) — Models 1-5 + PAF using the (I)ADL-removed FI
# Same data, same covariates, same exposures; only frailty swapped for
# frailty_noIADL (≥0.25 threshold reapplied to 36-item FI).
```{r}
# 0) Fail loudly if ELSA objects aren't in scope (prevents HRS contamination)
stopifnot(
  "idauniq"        %in% names(panel_df_eligible),
  "idauniq"        %in% names(baseline_df_eligible),
  "frailty_noIADL" %in% names(panel_df_eligible)
)

# ==========================================================================
# 1) Counting-process dataset with the noIADL FI
# ==========================================================================
baseline_invariant_elsa <- baseline_df_eligible %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, age) %>%
  rename(baseline_age = age)

df0_noIADL <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Gender, -Race, -Education, -Marital_status) %>%
  left_join(baseline_invariant_elsa, by = "idauniq") %>%
  mutate(
    year            = as.integer(year),
    baseline_year   = as.integer(baseline_year),
    time            = as.numeric(year - baseline_year),
    dementia        = as.integer(dementia),
    hearing_loss    = as.integer(hearing_loss),
    vision_overall  = as.integer(vision_overall),
    frailty_noIADL  = as.integer(frailty_noIADL),
    Employment      = factor(Employment),
    Smoking         = factor(Smoking),
    Alcohol         = factor(Alcohol),
    Gender          = factor(Gender),
    Race            = factor(Race),
    Education       = factor(Education),
    Marital_status  = factor(Marital_status),
    baseline_age    = as.numeric(baseline_age)
  ) %>%
  arrange(idauniq, time)

tv_dat_noIADL <- df0_noIADL %>%
  group_by(idauniq) %>%
  mutate(
    tstart             = lag(time),
    tstop              = time,
    event              = dementia,
    hearing_lag        = lag(hearing_loss),
    vision_lag         = lag(vision_overall),
    frailty_lag_noIADL = lag(frailty_noIADL),
    emp_lag            = lag(Employment),
    smoke_lag          = lag(Smoking),
    alcohol_lag        = lag(Alcohol)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(tstart), tstop > tstart) %>%
  group_by(idauniq) %>%
  mutate(event_cum = cumsum(event)) %>%
  filter(event_cum <= 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-event_cum)

tv_cc_noIADL <- tv_dat_noIADL %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(hearing_lag), !is.na(vision_lag), !is.na(frailty_lag_noIADL),
    !is.na(emp_lag),    !is.na(smoke_lag),  !is.na(alcohol_lag),
    !is.na(baseline_age),
    !is.na(Gender), !is.na(Race), !is.na(Education), !is.na(Marital_status)
  )

cat("[ELSA sensitivity] intervals:", nrow(tv_cc_noIADL),
    " | persons:", dplyr::n_distinct(tv_cc_noIADL$idauniq),
    " | events:", sum(tv_cc_noIADL$event), "\n")

# Sample comparability vs main analysis
if (exists("tv_cc")) {
  cat(sprintf("[Sample comparability] main N = %d, sensitivity N = %d, overlap = %d\n",
              dplyr::n_distinct(tv_cc$idauniq),
              dplyr::n_distinct(tv_cc_noIADL$idauniq),
              length(intersect(tv_cc$idauniq, tv_cc_noIADL$idauniq))))
}

# ==========================================================================
# 2) Models 1-4 (sensitivity)
# ==========================================================================
fit_m1_hearing_noIADL <- coxph(Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag + cluster(idauniq),
                               data = tv_cc_noIADL, ties = "efron")
fit_m1_vision_noIADL  <- coxph(Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag  + cluster(idauniq),
                               data = tv_cc_noIADL, ties = "efron")
fit_m1_frailty_noIADL <- coxph(Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ frailty_lag_noIADL + cluster(idauniq),
                               data = tv_cc_noIADL, ties = "efron")

summary(fit_m1_hearing_noIADL)

# ==========================================================================
# 3) Model 5 — ELSA-suffixed, self-contained helpers
# ==========================================================================
make_midyear_date_elsa <- function(y) lubridate::ymd(paste0(as.integer(y), "-06-15"))

build_m5_dataset_elsa <- function(panel_df, baseline_df,
                                  sensory_var, sensory_label,
                                  frailty_var = "frailty") {

  stopifnot(
    "idauniq"   %in% names(panel_df),
    "idauniq"   %in% names(baseline_df),
    sensory_var %in% names(panel_df),
    frailty_var %in% names(panel_df)
  )

  df_tv <- panel_df %>%
    mutate(
      idauniq       = as.character(idauniq),
      year          = as.integer(year),
      baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
      int_date      = make_midyear_date_elsa(year),
      baseline_date = make_midyear_date_elsa(baseline_year),
      time          = as.numeric(difftime(int_date, baseline_date,
                                          units = "days")) / 365.25,
      .sensory      = .data[[sensory_var]],
      .frailty      = .data[[frailty_var]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(idauniq, time) %>%
    group_by(idauniq) %>%
    mutate(
      sensory_onset_time = if (any(.sensory == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.sensory == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      frailty_onset_time = if (any(.frailty == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.frailty == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      dem_time           = if (any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[dementia == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(sensory_tv = dplyr::if_else(.sensory == 1, 1L, 0L)) %>%
    arrange(idauniq, time) %>%
    group_by(idauniq) %>%
    mutate(
      start = lag(time),
      stop  = time,
      dementia_event  = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dem_time) & stop == dem_time, 1L, 0L),
      frailty_by_stop = !is.na(frailty_onset_time) & frailty_onset_time <= stop,
      ctx_tv = case_when(
        sensory_tv == 0                     ~ 0L,
        sensory_tv == 1 & !frailty_by_stop  ~ 1L,
        sensory_tv == 1 &  frailty_by_stop  ~ 2L,
        TRUE                                ~ NA_integer_
      ),
      ctx_lag     = lag(ctx_tv),
      emp_lag     = lag(Employment),
      smoke_lag   = lag(Smoking),
      alcohol_lag = lag(Alcohol)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(start),
      stop > start,
      is.na(dem_time) | start < dem_time,
      !is.na(ctx_lag)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ctx_lag = factor(
        ctx_lag, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
        labels = c(paste0("No ", sensory_label, " (ref)"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", no frailty yet"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", frailty present"))
      ),
      emp_lag     = droplevels(factor(emp_lag)),
      smoke_lag   = droplevels(factor(smoke_lag)),
      alcohol_lag = droplevels(factor(alcohol_lag))
    )

  baseline_local <- baseline_df %>%
    dplyr::select(idauniq, Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, age) %>%
    rename(baseline_age = age) %>%
    mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq))

  df_tv %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Gender", "Race", "Education", "Marital_status"))) %>%
    left_join(baseline_local, by = "idauniq") %>%
    mutate(
      baseline_age   = as.numeric(baseline_age),
      Gender         = droplevels(factor(Gender)),
      Race           = droplevels(factor(Race)),
      Education      = droplevels(factor(Education)),
      Marital_status = droplevels(factor(Marital_status))
    )
}

fit_m5_elsa <- function(dat, label) {
  stopifnot("idauniq" %in% names(dat))

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(label, "Model 5 (3-level, reference = No sensory impairment)\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Intervals:", nrow(dat),
      "| Events:",  sum(dat$dementia_event),
      "| People:",  dplyr::n_distinct(dat$idauniq), "\n\n")

  cat("Category distribution (lagged, interval-level):\n")
  print(table(dat$ctx_lag, useNA = "ifany"))

  cat("\nEvents by category:\n")
  print(
    dat %>%
      group_by(ctx_lag) %>%
      summarise(intervals = n(), events = sum(dementia_event),
                .groups = "drop")
  )

  fit <- coxph(
    Surv(start, stop, dementia_event) ~
      ctx_lag + baseline_age +
      Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
      emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag,
    data = dat, cluster = idauniq, ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit
  )

  cat("\n--- Cox fit ---\n");  print(summary(fit))
  cat("\n--- PH check ---\n"); print(cox.zph(fit))
  fit
}

contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_elsa <- function(fit, label) {
  co <- coef(fit)
  vc <- vcov(fit)
  i_no_fr  <- grep("no frailty yet",  names(co))
  i_fr_yes <- grep("frailty present", names(co))
  stopifnot(length(i_no_fr) == 1, length(i_fr_yes) == 1)

  L <- numeric(length(co))
  L[i_fr_yes] <-  1
  L[i_no_fr]  <- -1

  est <- sum(L * co)
  se  <- sqrt(t(L) %*% vc %*% L)[1, 1]
  z   <- est / se
  p   <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n[%s] log-HR(frailty present) - log-HR(no frailty yet) = %.3f (SE %.3f), z = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
    label, est, se, z, p
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "  Ratio of HRs (frailty present / no frailty yet) = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)\n",
    exp(est), exp(est - 1.96 * se), exp(est + 1.96 * se)
  ))
  invisible(list(estimate = est, se = se, p = p,
                 ratio = exp(est),
                 ci = exp(est + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)))
}

# Build & fit sensitivity M5
df_tv_hearing_noIADL <- build_m5_dataset_elsa(
  panel_df_eligible, baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var = "hearing_loss",   sensory_label = "Hearing loss",
  frailty_var = "frailty_noIADL"
)
df_tv_vision_noIADL  <- build_m5_dataset_elsa(
  panel_df_eligible, baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var = "vision_overall", sensory_label = "Vision loss",
  frailty_var = "frailty_noIADL"
)

fit_m5_hearing_noIADL <- fit_m5_elsa(df_tv_hearing_noIADL, "HEARING (noIADL)")
fit_m5_vision_noIADL  <- fit_m5_elsa(df_tv_vision_noIADL,  "VISION (noIADL)")

contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_elsa(fit_m5_hearing_noIADL, "HEARING (noIADL)")
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_elsa(fit_m5_vision_noIADL,  "VISION (noIADL)")
```

```{r}
# 4) PAF — sensitivity (helpers also _elsa-suffixed and self-contained)
# ==========================================================================
set.seed(20260509)

paf_binary_fn_elsa <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

paf_ci_binary_elsa <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = 10000) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]
  stopifnot(!is.na(b), V > 0)
  sims <- rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))
  pafs <- paf_binary_fn_elsa(p, exp(sims))
  tibble(
    HR  = exp(b),
    PAF = paf_binary_fn_elsa(p, exp(b)),
    lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

paf_ci_multicat_elsa <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels, nsim = 10000) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))
  HRs <- exp(sims)
  comp_mat <- sweep(HRs - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_all    <- rowSums(comp_mat)
  paf_total_sim <- s_all / (1 + s_all)
  paf_comp_sim  <- comp_mat / (1 + s_all)

  HR_est    <- exp(b)
  comp_est  <- p_vec * (HR_est - 1)
  s_all_est <- sum(comp_est)

  tibble(
    component = c("Total", labels),
    HR        = c(NA_real_, HR_est),
    PAF       = c(s_all_est / (1 + s_all_est),
                  comp_est  / (1 + s_all_est)),
    lcl       = c(unname(quantile(paf_total_sim, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  apply(paf_comp_sim, 2,
                        function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)))),
    ucl       = c(unname(quantile(paf_total_sim, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  apply(paf_comp_sim, 2,
                        function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))))
  )
}

prev_pt_binary_elsa <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  sum(pt[x == 1], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
}

prev_pt_factor_elsa <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    level = levels(x),
    p     = vapply(levels(x),
                   function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                   numeric(1))
  )
}

p_hearing_s <- prev_pt_binary_elsa(tv_cc_noIADL, "hearing_lag",         "tstart", "tstop")
p_vision_s  <- prev_pt_binary_elsa(tv_cc_noIADL, "vision_lag",          "tstart", "tstop")
p_frailty_s <- prev_pt_binary_elsa(tv_cc_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL",  "tstart", "tstop")

cat("\n[ELSA sensitivity] Person-time prevalence:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Hearing loss        : %.4f\n", p_hearing_s))
cat(sprintf("  Vision loss         : %.4f\n", p_vision_s))
cat(sprintf("  Frailty (no (I)ADL) : %.4f\n", p_frailty_s))

paf_row_elsa <- function(fit, term, p, model_label, exposure_label) {
  res <- paf_ci_binary_elsa(fit, term, p)
  tibble(
    model    = model_label,
    exposure = exposure_label,
    p_pt     = p,
    HR       = res$HR,
    PAF      = res$PAF,
    PAF_lcl  = res$lcl,
    PAF_ucl  = res$ucl
  )
}

paf_models_1_4_noIADL <- bind_rows(
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m1_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M1 (unadjusted)",                     "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m1_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M1 (unadjusted)",                     "Vision loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m1_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M1 (unadjusted)",                     "Frailty (noIADL)"),

  paf_row_elsa(fit_m2_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M2 (+ age)",                          "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m2_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M2 (+ age)",                          "Vision loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m2_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M2 (+ age)",                          "Frailty (noIADL)"),

  paf_row_elsa(fit_m3_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m3_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m3_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)", "Frailty (noIADL)"),

  paf_row_elsa(fit_m4_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj, noIADL)",    "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m4_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj, noIADL)",    "Vision loss"),
  paf_row_elsa(fit_m4_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M4 (mutually adjusted, noIADL)",      "Frailty (noIADL)")
)

paf_model5_elsa <- function(fit, dat, model_label) {
  stopifnot(is.factor(dat$ctx_lag))
  ctx_levels   <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)
  exposed_lvls <- ctx_levels[-1]

  prev_tab  <- prev_pt_factor_elsa(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")
  p_exposed <- setNames(prev_tab$p[match(exposed_lvls, prev_tab$level)],
                        exposed_lvls)
  stopifnot(all(!is.na(p_exposed)), all(p_exposed > 0))

  terms <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed_lvls)
  miss  <- setdiff(terms, names(coef(fit)))
  if (length(miss))
    stop("Missing coefficients in Model 5 fit: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  tab <- paf_ci_multicat_elsa(fit, terms, p_exposed, exposed_lvls)
  tab %>%
    mutate(
      model    = model_label,
      exposure = component,
      p_pt     = c(NA_real_, unname(p_exposed))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl = lcl, PAF_ucl = ucl)
}

paf_m5_hearing_noIADL <- paf_model5_elsa(fit_m5_hearing_noIADL, df_tv_hearing_noIADL,
                                         "M5 (hearing context, noIADL)")
paf_m5_vision_noIADL  <- paf_model5_elsa(fit_m5_vision_noIADL,  df_tv_vision_noIADL,
                                         "M5 (vision context, noIADL)")

paf_all_noIADL <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4_noIADL,
                            paf_m5_hearing_noIADL,
                            paf_m5_vision_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                     100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_CI)

cat("\n=== ELSA SENSITIVITY PAF summary (Models 1-5, no-(I)ADL FI) ===\n")
print(paf_all_noIADL, n = Inf)

# ==========================================================================
# 5) Side-by-side: main vs sensitivity (ELSA)
# ==========================================================================
if (exists("paf_all")) {
  paf_compare <- bind_rows(
    paf_all        %>% mutate(analysis = "Main (49-item FI)"),
    paf_all_noIADL %>% mutate(analysis = "Sensitivity (noIADL FI)")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(analysis, model, exposure, HR, PAF, PAF_CI) %>%
    arrange(model, exposure, analysis)

  cat("\n=== ELSA: main vs sensitivity (HR + PAF side-by-side) ===\n")
  print(paf_compare, n = Inf)
}
```
